headline: Approved minutes of the previous regular meeting; discussed Sergeant and Lieutenant promotions with no vote recorded.
summary: Members approved the minutes of an earlier meeting by a unanimous vote. The agenda included a discussion of Sergeant and Lieutenant promotions. The minutes record no vote on those promotions.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the July 8, 2026 regular meeting; the vote was unanimous.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner Ladore made a motion to approve the minutes of the Police Commission regular meeting of July 8, 2026. Commissioner King seconded the motion. The vote was unanimous in favor.

decision_titles: Minutes of the July 8, 2026 regular meeting
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Police Commission Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
5:30 PM, August 12, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Police 
Department  
Conference Room 
2900 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 Chairman Willis called the Police Commission regular meeting to order at 5:45 PM 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 The Traffic Authority Clerk, Nancy Forvil, took a roll call. Commissioner's present: Willis, 
Zachery, Jones, King and Ladore. 
 
Staff: Chief Reynolds, Deputy Chief Sigmon and Attorney Sharkey. 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
 
  a. Approval of minutes of the Police Commission regular meeting on July 8, 2026 and 
special meeting on July 13, 2026  
  Commissioner Ladore made a motion to approve the minutes of the Police 
Commission regular meeting of July 8, 2026. Commissioner King seconded the 
motion. The vote was unanimous in favor. 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 There was no public comment. 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 There was no correspondence. 
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 There was no executive session. 
7. REPORTS   
 
 
  a. Hamden Police Department July 2026 Monthly Report
b. Hamden Police Department July 2026 Crime Statistics Report  
  
 
  c. Hamden Police Department July 2026 Traffic Stops Report  
  
 
8. OLD BUSINESS   
 There was no old business. 
9. NEW BUSINESS   
 
 
  a. Discussion on Sergeant and Lieutenant promotions.  
  
 
10. ADJOURNMENT   
 There being no further business to discuss, Commissioner Ladore made a motion to adjourn 
the Police Commission's regular meeting. Commissioner King seconded the motion. The vote 
was unanimous in favor. The meeting adjourned at 6:20 PM.

1. CALL TO ORDER   
 Chairman Willis called the Police Commission special meeting to order at 6:31 PM 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 The Traffic Authority Clerk, Nancy Forvil, took a roll call. Commissioner's present: Willis, 
Zachery, Hampton, Jones, White and Ladore. 
 
Town Attorney, Sue Gruen, Attorney Michael Jefferson, Attorney Nicolas Grello and Chief 
Reynolds. 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 (There were no minutes) 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 Attorney Francesco Picone 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 (There was no correspondence) 
6. REPORTS   
 (There were no reports) 
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 At 6:34 PM, Commissioner Ladore made a motion to enter executive session to interview 
(2) two candidates for one Lieutenant position. Commissioner Zachery seconded the 
motion. The vote was unanimous in favor.  
 
(Attorneys Nick Grello, Michael Jefferson and Sue Gruen attended the executive session).  
 
At 8:49 PM, Commissioner Ladore made a motion to come out of executive session to vote 
and promote one (1) Lieutenant Officer. Commissioner Hampton seconded the motion.
The vote was unanimous in favor.  
 
At 8:50 PM, the Police Commissioners voted: 
 
2 yay votes for Sergeant Angela Vey-Glass 
2 yay votes for Sergeant Mark Atwater 
2 abstained votes 
 
(No candidates were promoted) 
  a. Interview (2) two candidates for one Lieutenant position. The candidates under 
consideration for this promotion are: 
 
Sergeant Angela Vey-Glass 
Sergeant Mark Atwater 
   
  
 
8. OLD BUSINESS   
 (There was no old business) 
9. NEW BUSINESS   
 (There was no new business) 
10. ADJOURNMENT   
 There being no further business to discuss, Commissioner Ladore made a motion to 
adjourn the Police Commission's special meeting. Commissioner Jones seconded the 
motion. The vote was unanimous in favor. The meeting adjourned at 8:50 PM.

 The Police Commission clerk, Nancy Forvil, took a roll call. Commissioner's present: Willis, 
White, King, Zachery, Jones, and Ladore. 
 
Staff: Attorney Brendan Sharkey 
Hamden Police Department staff: Chief Reynolds and Lieutenant Mansfield. 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
 
  a. Approval of minutes of the Police Commission regular meeting on June 10, 2026.  
  Commissioner Ladore made a motion to approve the minutes of the Police 
Commission regular meeting of June 10, 2026. Commissioner White seconded the 
motion. The vote was unanimous in favor. 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 (There was no public comment) 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last

also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 Presented by Chief Reynolds. 
  a. Hamden Police Department Correspondence  
  
 
6. REPORTS   
 Presented by Lieutenant Mansfield. 
  a. Hamden Police Department June 2026 Monthly Report, Crime Statistics and Traffic 
Stops.
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 At 6:07 PM, Commissioner White made a motion to enter executive session to interview (3) 
three candidates for one deputy chief position and interview (2) two candidates for two 
certified police officer positions. Commissioner Jones seconded the motion. The vote was 
unanimous in favor. 
 
At 7:48 PM, Commissioner Ladore made a motion to come out of executive session to vote 
and promote one (1) Deputy Chief Officer and hire two certified police officers. 
Commissioner Zachery seconded the motion. The vote was unanimous in favor. 
 
The Police Commission voted to promote Lieutenant Micheal Sigmon to Deputy Chief 
Officer and hire Donald Matejek and Juan Garcia as certified officers.  
  a. Interview (3) three candidates for one deputy chief position. The candidates under 
consideration for this promotion are: 
 
Captain Jason Venditto 
Lieutenant Michael Sigmon 
Lieutenant Eric Goclowski 
 
Interview (2) two candidates for two certified police officer positions. The candidates 
under consideration for this hire are: 
 
Donald Matejek 
Juan Garcia  
  
 
8. OLD BUSINESS   
 (There was no old business) 
9. NEW BUSINESS   
 (There was no new business) 
10. ADJOURNMENT   
 There being no further business to discuss, Commissioner Ladore made a motion to adjourn 
the Police Commission's regular meeting. Commissioner White seconded the motion. The 
vote was unanimous in favor. The meeting adjourned at 7:56 PM.
